units: <cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 5:5">Pirké d’R. El. ch. V</cite> <he>לברך צִמְחָהּ של ארץ</he> to bless the growth of the earth.
<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 5:5">Ib.</cite> <he>הארץ מתעברת וצמחה כאשה וכ׳</he> the earth becomes pregnant, and what she produces is like the issue of a widow that conceived in whoredom.

<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 5:5">Ib.</cite> <he>וצמחה … ברכה</he> and what she produces is a blessed seed. Tanḥ. Ki Thetsé 4 and the people say, <he>זה צ׳ רשע</he> this is a wicked growth (the father of a wicked son); a. e.—Pl. <he>צְמָחִים</he>, <he>צְמָהִין</he>.

Y. Shek. I, beg. 45ᵈ לא כדי שיהו הצ׳ ניכרין is it not (necessary to wait with the examination) until the growths are sufficiently advanced to be distinguishable?; a. e.—Trnsf. morbid growths, swellings, ulcers, eruptions.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 85a:8">B. Kam. 85ᵃ</cite> <he>אם עלו בו צ׳ מחמת המכה וכ׳</he> if ulcers grew on his body in consequence of the wound, so that the wound is covered up.
<cite ref="Chullin 48a:2">Ḥull. 48ᵃ</cite> <he>העלתה צ׳</he> if the lungs have ulcers (or blisters); a. e.
